name: genpet
description: A story-driven pixel companion for Codex with native Pet updates.

interface.shortDescription: Adopt your one-of-a-kind interactive ChatGPT pet!
interface.longDescription: An interactive pet that grows up, for the ChatGPT (Codex) desktop client. Based on your background information, it comes to you through a short adventure, and like a real pet it watches you, keeps you company, grows and evolves, changes how it looks, decorates its own home, goes out on trips, and brings you small gifts. Built on ChatGPT's own pet system: it shows on your desktop, stays in sync across devices through ChatGPT's pet cloud sync, and can be the face of dots.
defaultPrompt: 使用 $genpet 查看我的宠物和最近的故事
